metadata.title: Country Pop Portrait with Paisley Textures

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up glamour portrait of a woman with vibrant copper-red hair, set against a stylized background of interlocking teal and lime green paisley patterns. The lighting is soft and high-key, emphasizing blue eye makeup and silver hoop earrings, with a prominent script logo in the lower left.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between copper hair and teal background elements
Repetition of circular forms in the earrings, paisley swirls, and script loops
Textural contrast between smooth skin and intricate vector background patterns
Diagonal eye path from the top-left text to the central face to the bottom-left logo
coreInvariants: Teal and lime green color palette for background
Soft, diffused studio lighting with minimal shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, head and shoulders, filling approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, centered horizontally and slightly above the vertical midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left sans-serif text, moves down the subject's face, and settles on the large script logo at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is densely packed with patterns, but the subject's face provides a clear visual rest area.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the hair and background; high value/brightness in the skin tones for a glowing effect.

letterConstructionRules: Display script features long, sweeping swashes and loops
Secondary text uses a heavy, rounded geometric sans-serif
Both styles utilize a soft drop shadow or outer glow for legibility against busy backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'R' in the script has an oversized top loop that extends over the subsequent letters
The 'a' in the script has a long, trailing terminal
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, heavy sans-serif and a fluid, airy script.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, casual monoline script feel

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Gotham Black or Futura Extra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, geometric lowercase sans-serif style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key glamour portrait of a woman with copper-red hair and blue eyes. Background should be a collage of teal and lime green sections separated by curved lines, overlaid with delicate white paisley vector patterns. Subject wears silver hoop earrings.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, light-blue monoline script name in the bottom left with a white outline. In the top left, stack four lines of lowercase white geometric sans-serif text with a thin teal outline.

verificationChecks: Is the hair color a vibrant copper-red?
Are the paisley patterns fine-lined and white?
Is the script text in the bottom left fluid and looping?
Is the color palette strictly teal, lime, and copper?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the lime green accents
Thickness of the script lettering stroke
Tightness of the stacked sans-serif leading
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Check for color harmony between hair and teal elements
Ensure script text does not obscure the eyes
Verify the paisley pattern is not too distracting from the face
Confirm the sans-serif text is perfectly stacked and centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait Subject [Copper Hair] + Background [Teal/Lime Paisley Collage] + Typography [Bottom-Left Script + Top-Left Stacked Sans-Serif]
